001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop;
002
003import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.QuickShopAPI;
004import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.inventory.ShopInventory;
005import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.meta.ShopDisplay;
006import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.meta.ShopMeta;
007import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.permission.ShopPermission;
008import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.trading.ShopTrading;
009import org.bukkit.NamespacedKey;
010import org.bukkit.block.Block;
011import org.bukkit.configuration.ConfigurationSection;
012import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
013import org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin;
014import org.jetbrains.annotations.ApiStatus;
015import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
016import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
017
018import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;
019
020/**
021 * A shop
022 */
023public interface Shop<U, L> extends Locatable<L>, ShopInventory, ShopMeta<U>, ShopTrading, ShopDisplay, ShopPermission {
024
025  NamespacedKey SHOP_NAMESPACED_KEY = new NamespacedKey(QuickShopAPI.getPluginInstance(), "shopsign");
026
027  /**
028   * Get shop's item durability, if have.
029   *
030   * @return Shop's item durability
031   */
032  short getDurability();
033
034  /**
035   * Getting ConfigurationSection (extra data) instance of your plugin namespace)
036   *
037   * @param plugin The plugin and plugin name will used for namespace
038   *
039   * @return ExtraSection, save it through Shop#setExtra. If you don't save it, it may randomly lose
040   * or save
041   */
042  @NotNull
043  ConfigurationSection getExtra(@NotNull Plugin plugin);
044
045  /**
046   * Check shop is or not attached the target block
047   *
048   * @param paramBlock Target {@link Block}
049   *
050   * @return isAttached
051   */
052  boolean isAttached(@NotNull Block paramBlock);
053
054  /**
055   * Gets if shop is dirty (so shop will be save)
056   *
057   * @return Is dirty
058   */
059  boolean isDirty();
060
061  /**
062   * Sets dirty status
063   *
064   * @param isDirty Shop is dirty
065   */
066  void setDirty(boolean isDirty);
067
068  /**
069   * Get this container shop is loaded or unloaded.
070   *
071   * @return Loaded
072   */
073  boolean isLoaded();
074
075  /**
076   * Whether Shop is valid
077   *
078   * @return status
079   */
080  boolean isValid();
081
082  /**
083   * Execute codes when player click the shop will did things
084   */
085  void onClick(@NotNull Player clicker);
086
087
088  @Deprecated()
089  @ApiStatus.Internal
090  void handleLoading();
091
092  @Deprecated()
093  @ApiStatus.Internal
094  void handleUnloading(boolean dontTouchWorld);
095
096  /**
097   * open a preview for shop item
098   *
099   * @param player The viewer {@link Player}
100   */
101  void openPreview(@NotNull Player player);
102
103  /**
104   * Save the plugin extra data to Json format
105   *
106   * @return The json string
107   */
108  @NotNull
109  String saveExtraToYaml();
110
111  /**
112   * Getting ShopInfoStorage that you can use for storage the shop data
113   *
114   * @return ShopInfoStorage
115   */
116  ShopInfoStorage saveToInfoStorage();
117
118  /**
119   * Gets the symbol link that created by InventoryWrapperManager
120   *
121   * @return InventoryWrapper
122   */
123  @NotNull
124  String saveToSymbolLink();
125
126  /**
127   * Sets shop is dirty
128   */
129  void setDirty();
130
131  /**
132   * Save the extra data to the shop.
133   *
134   * @param plugin Plugin instance
135   * @param data   The data table, or null to remove it
136   */
137  void setExtra(@NotNull Plugin plugin, @Nullable ConfigurationSection data);
138
139  /**
140   * Update shop data to database
141   */
142  @NotNull
143  CompletableFuture<Void> update();
144
145  /**
146   * Update shop data to database synchronously. This will create the completeable future for the save
147   * function, and wait for it to complete. DON'T USE IF YOU DON'T KNOW WHAT YOU'RE DOING!
148   *
149   * @throws RuntimeException
150   */
151  void updateSync() throws RuntimeException;
152}
